title.zh: 规定在南哥打巴托省Surala市镇设立医院，名称为Surala总医院，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a Hospital in the Municipality of Surala, Province of South Cotabato, to be Known as Surala General Hospital, and Authorizing the Appropriations of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a Hospital in the Municipality of Surala, Province of South Cotabato, to be Known as Surala General Hospital, and Authorizing the Appropriations of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Bệnh viện tại Thị trấn Surala, Tỉnh South Cotabato với tên gọi Bệnh viện Đa khoa Surala, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงพยาบาลในเทศบาล Surala จังหวัด South Cotabato ในชื่อโรงพยาบาลทั่วไป Surala และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Rumah Sakit di Kotamadya Surala, Provinsi South Cotabato dengan nama Rumah Sakit Umum Surala, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Hospital di Perbandaran Surala, Wilayah South Cotabato dengan nama Hospital Besar Surala, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5397_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established under the direct supervision of the Director of Medical Services a hospital in the Municipality of Surala, Province of South Cotabato, to be known as the Surala General Hospital to serve the medical needs of the new Province of South Cotabato.

The sum of two hundred fifty thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said hospital during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-nine. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
